text:
maria: Heads-up — staging CI started failing after the KMS key rotation this morning. Also seeing a sudden bump in SAST findings on the same PR. Anyone oncall?
ops-oncall: I’m here, investigating CI logs now. Can you paste the build failure?
maria: Paste below — error came from artifact decrypt step.
---
build: decrypt artifact failed: grpc: code = Unknown desc = failed to unwrap data: kms: decryption failed (KeyUnavailable)
Command: `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=artifact.enc --plaintext-file=artifact.tar`
---
jonathan: That KeyUnavailable is likely because the new rotation policy didn't grant the CI service account the new key version IAM binding. Did we update the grant step in the rotation script?
maria: We rotated with the auto-rotate job but I think the ephemeral grant step failed (network hiccup). The PR touching auth/ was merged last night — could be related.
scanbot: New SAST run for PR #4821 produced 12 new findings: mostly `WeakCryptoUsage` in generated client cert code and `HardcodedSecret` false positives in test fixtures. Link: https://ci.internal/reports/4821
anya: Are the SAST hits blocking the pipeline or just warnings? Product needs the deploy.
ops-oncall: Pipeline is blocked because decrypt step failed, not the scan. SAST is showing up as failing the gating rules though — that’s a secondary issue.
jonathan: For SAST false positives we should mark the test fixtures as `skip-scan` via inline annotation. For the WeakCrypto ones: check if it’s code generated by the SDK — if so, we either patch generator or suppress with documented rationale.
raj: On the KMS side I can temporary re-grant decrypt to the CI service account to unblock, but we need an audit trail and TTL for the grant. We should not leave broad perms.
maria: Agreed — temporary grant + audit entry. Raj can you do 15m temporary grant and then we rotate back? Also we need to record the decision in the incident ticket.
raj: Doing now — granting `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on key-version `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/deploy-key/cryptoKeyVersions/5` to `ci-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com` for 15 minutes. I’ll emit a policy change event and tag with `#incident-2837654321`.
sec-bot: POLICY-CHANGE: grant applied by raj at 2026-03-20T15:07Z. Expires at 2026-03-20T15:22Z. Audit ID: a7c3d9f2.
maria: Thanks. On SAST: jonathan, can you triage the 12 findings and mark the test fixture FPs in the scan UI? If we must suppress, add an exemption ticket with owner and TTL.
jonathan: Will do. Quick checklist proposal in-thread for this flow (we should add to the playbook doc):
1) If CI decrypt fails after key rotation -> temp-grant with audit + tag incident.
2) Unblock deploy only if audit shows grant was limited and timeboxed.
3) Triage SAST/DAST findings: classify FP vs code issue within 30m.
4) For false positives in generated code -> file upstream generator issue + temporary suppression with owner and expiry.
5) For real findings -> open JIRA, assign dev, block merge until fix or accepted risk.
6) Post-incident: update rotation script to include idempotent grant and retry + alert on grant failure.
anyA: (typo) — anya: Also add a step to update our `sdlc/security-oncall` runbook with the KMS troubleshooting snippet.
maria: Good call. Add command examples to the runbook, e.g.:
```
# Check current key bindings for service account
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy deploy-key --keyring=artifacts --location=global --project=redwood | grep -A2 "ci-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"

# Decrypt test locally (if you have key access)
gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=artifact.enc --plaintext-file=artifact.tar --location=global --keyring=artifacts --key=deploy-key
```
jonathan: Also include quick SAST triage commands: `scanctl show --pr 4821 --filter WeakCryptoUsage` and link to the suppression policy: https://internal/docs/security/sast-suppression
ops-oncall: CI is green after grant. Re-run shows artifact decrypted and deploy continued.
sec-bot: AUDIT: temporary grant used by ci-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2026-03-20T15:09Z. Action logged.
maria: Thanks team. Action items: raj -> add retry+alert to rotation job (due EOD). jonathan -> triage SAST findings and file generator issue if applicable (due 4h). anya -> update runbook with commands and playbook snippet (due EOD). I’ll update the incident ticket with timeline and links.
jonathan: Triage done quick notes: 8 FPs in test fixtures (marked), 2 generator WeakCrypto (filed issue #S-129), 2 real findings in `auth/client.go` (created JIRA RDW-211, assigned to @olivia).
maria: Perfect. Closing thread; keep the ticket updated. :white_check_mark:
